title: incident-bot: add on-call runbook linking and auto-diagnostics summary for SLO alerts
description: Motivation: On-call engineers need faster access to relevant runbooks and a compact diagnostics summary when SLO alerts fire. This PR extends incident-bot and the slo-toolkit utilities to: 1) automatically attach ranked runbook links to alerts based on service tags and historical incident matches, 2) include a concise automated diagnostics summary (top failing checks, recent error rate spikes, recent deploys) in the alert body, and 3) add an opt-in on-call notification modifier that pings the secondary on-call after N minutes if an alert is acknowledged but not resolved. Scope: incident-bot handlers, slo-toolkit diagnostics module, and tests + docs. Checklist: - [x] Implement runbook linker and ranking heuristics - [x] Produce diagnostics summary payload with bounded size - [x] Add secondary-ping opt-in and config flag - [x] Unit tests for ranking and summary formatting - [x] Integration tests against staging alert stream - [x] Update runbooks index and incident-bot README Description of changes and commits: commits: - "feat(incident-bot): add runbook linker that matches alerts to runbooks by service, keywords, and past incident fingerprints" - "feat(slo-toolkit): diagnostics summary generator (error-rate delta, top traces, recent deploys) and size limit sanitization" - "feat(incident-bot): secondary on-call ping flow + config flag and backoff" - "test: add unit/integration tests for linker and diagnostics" High-level files changed: - cmd/incident-bot/main.go (new runbook linker wiring, config flags) - internal/incidentbot/runbook_linker.go (ranking heuristics, caching) - internal/incidentbot/notify_secondary.go (ping flow) - pkg/slo/diagnostics.go (summary generator, sanitization) - pkg/slo/diagnostics_test.go (unit tests) - docs/oncall-runbooks.md (runtime docs + examples) - infra/staging/alert-sim.json (test fixture) Review summary and conversation (high-level): - Samir Rao (reviewer): requested clearer limits on diagnostics payload size and fallback when runbook index is incomplete. - Author (Avery Chen): responded with explicit 2KB cap and truncation policy; added fallback to search via tags and a best-effort URL to the runbooks index. - Lina Martínez (reviewer): asked for e2e staging logs and a short runbook for secondary ping behavior; author added integration run and doc. - Jesse Park (approver): approved after tests green and docs updated. CI and checks: - CI status: pass (flake rerun once; one transient integration timeout fixed) - Checks run: build (pass), unit-tests (pass), integration-tests (pass), linters (pass), security-scan (pass) Backwards compatibility and rollout: - New behaviour is opt-in via incident-bot config (incident_bot.enable_runbook_links, enable_secondary_ping). Existing customers see no change until flags enabled. - Feature gate added to default staging config; rollout plan: enable in staging -> canary enable for two low-traffic services -> broad rollout. Observability and metrics added: - incident_bot.runbook_link.success (counter) - incident_bot.runbook_link.fallback (counter) - incident_bot.diagnostics.truncated (counter) Release notes: See release_notes field for user-facing summary. Merge notes: Squash-merged to main after approvals and green CI. Deployment: config flags will be toggled in staging via infra PR; no DB migrations. Related Linear: ["ENG-3021", "ENG-3098", "OPS-117"] Related Jira: ["SUP-812"]
author: Avery Chen
release_notes: incident-bot: optional automatic runbook linking and short automated diagnostics summary for SLO alerts; opt-in secondary on-call ping behavior. Config flags: incident_bot.enable_runbook_links, incident_bot.enable_secondary_ping. No breaking changes.
